title: A tab left open across another tab's log-off shows a 'could not be reached' message when its switch is refused
evidence: prepareSwitch (widget-src/standalone/connect.ts) catches any copy-down failure as '<provider> could not be reached, so your record there could not be copied to this browser.' A tab whose on-device writes are refused (healthWritesAllowed, widget-src/src/lib/storage.ts) has its copy-down refused at LocalStorageAdapter.writeSync, so the switch stops, which is right, but the message names the wrong cause.
